description: This file defines an API service object for QoS (Quality of Service) management, providing methods to get and update bandwidth and QoS rules by calling imported API functions.

methods.name: getBandwidth
methods.description: Fetches QoS bandwidth data via the external getQosBandwidth API method.

methods.name: updateBandwidth
methods.description: Updates QoS bandwidth configuration using the external updateQosBandwidth API method.

methods.name: getRule
methods.description: Retrieves QoS rule data via the external getQosRule API method.

methods.name: updateRule
methods.description: Updates QoS rule data via the external updateQosRule API method.
